m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I'm not a number, I'm a free Mantis!
Thank you for freeing me! I did not think I could last much longer. My stars... you are a strange lot, aren't you?
Are you here to sabotage the Shadow Weapons?
At first, they questioned me about the Last Wood. But of late, they were desperate to know about a Wizard - I gather that's you?
I overheard them discussing these new, incredibly deadly weapons they are crafting.
Are you sure you want to spend time investigating these Shadow Weapons?
Probably a prisoner. We have caught many of your people over the years. It sounded like a Burrower being put to the question.
Regardless, if it's an Interrogation Room, Ghost Dog likely isn't there. Shall we skip it? :Tsssk:
A prisoner? We must investigate! This way!
:Tsssk: We had best follow the little knight, before he gets himself killed.
